reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed fixed-design bulk RNA-seq negative-binomial treatment-minus-control inference at independent allocation level, with immutable workflow and source-difference audit; no executed data or predictive training task.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original RNA-seq Methods, supplements and release-specific validated tool/import protocols to select and verify transferable settings. Future source comparison or recording chosen settings is insufficient.

checks.quote: normalization method would be named and frozen
checks.reason: The normalization and low-count eligibility procedure are deferred rather than operationally chosen. Recording settings later is not a concrete calibration-to-choice rule. Unknown version/path/numeric placeholders themselves are not penalized.

checks.quote: platform/process performance and blinded pilot distributions
checks.reason: No objective reference/control accuracy or false-rejection criterion maps the pilot distribution to assay acceptance. The required calibration is named, not operationalized.

checks.quote: compare defensible normalization, filtering, or exclusion choices
checks.reason: No bounded set/range of alternatives or procedure deriving bounds and stopping before confirmation.
Revisions and adapted pilot reuse are logged, but changes following failed/ambiguous analysis lack explicit refreezing and fresh independent confirmation.

No operational orthogonal assay, independently specified alternative quantification/inference comparison or independent biological confirmation. Generic sensitivity choices and deterministic reruns do not supply independent validation.
Clean reruns, companion tables and tolerances are proposed, but runtime/memory/resource and failed-step recording are not explicitly specified as part of the computational verification contract.

Primary route is prospectively specified count-contrast inference, not prediction or feature-selection performance assessment. Its blinded pilot/calibration and frozen confirmatory specification are described; predictive train/test leakage is not an additional deduction. Independent/orthogonal confirmation is assessed separately under P14.

Remaining deductions concern executable calibration, sensitivity/confirmation and resource verification.
